exclude.reason: a user-run kustomize example that switches optional features off; it only deletes CustomResourceDefinitions from the rendered gateway manifest and defines none
exclude.evidence: Read at v1.28.0 and v1.33.7: the header says to run it with kubectl kustomize on examples/optional-features/; its only resource is ../render/contour-gateway.yaml and its patches are JSON6902 argument additions plus $patch delete entries for extensionservices.projectcontour.io and the grpcroutes, tlsroutes, tcproutes and udproutes Gateway API definitions. The generator scripts (hack/generate-deployment.sh, generate-gateway-deployment.sh, generate-gateway-yaml.sh, generate-crd-yaml.sh) read only examples/contour, examples/gateway and examples/deployment, and the Makefile names neither this directory nor examples/render.
